author: andhet
name: uncrop
description: uncrop.lua restores the full uncropped sensor image on Ricoh/Pentax raws (Pentax K-1, Ricoh GR III) by rewriting EXIF crop metadata via exiftool.
description-extensive: This adds an 'uncrop' command that recovers the full sensor image from certain Pentax and Ricoh cameras (the Pentax K-1 and Ricoh GR III) which normally crop a little off the edges. When you run it on a selected photo, it rewrites the file's built-in crop information so darktable shows the complete, uncropped frame. It requires the free exiftool program to be installed.
